fake-tears.label: Fake Tears
fake-tears.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

transform.label: Transform
transform.effect: User becomes a copy of the target until it leaves battle.

wish.label: Wish
wish.effect: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.

sharpen.label: Sharpen
sharpen.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

conversion.label: Conversion
conversion.effect: User’s type changes to the type of one of its moves at random.

conversion-2.label: Conversion 2
conversion-2.effect: Changes the user’s type to a random type either resistant or immune to the last move used against it.

bide.label: Bide
bide.effect: User waits for two turns, then hits back for twice the damage it took.

spider-web.label: Spider Web
spider-web.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

volt-tackle.label: Volt Tackle
volt-tackle.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

cotton-spore.label: Cotton Spore
cotton-spore.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

morning-sun.label: Morning Sun
morning-sun.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP. Affected by weather.

magic-coat.label: Magic Coat
magic-coat.effect: Reflects back the first effect move used on the user this turn.

iron-defense.label: Iron Defense
iron-defense.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

extrasensory.label: Extrasensory
extrasensory.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

sketch.label: Sketch
sketch.effect: Permanently becomes the target’s last used move.

triple-kick.label: Triple Kick
triple-kick.effect: Hits three times, increasing power by 100% with each successful hit.

milk-drink.label: Milk Drink
milk-drink.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.

aeroblast.label: Aeroblast
aeroblast.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

sacred-fire.label: Sacred Fire
sacred-fire.effect: Has a chance to burn the target. Lets frozen Pokémon thaw themselves.

leaf-blade.label: Leaf Blade
leaf-blade.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

blaze-kick.label: Blaze Kick
blaze-kick.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to burn the target.

whirlpool.label: Whirlpool
whirlpool.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.

muddy-water.label: Muddy Water
muddy-water.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

slack-off.label: Slack Off
slack-off.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.

tail-glow.label: Tail Glow
tail-glow.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack by three stages.

water-spout.label: Water Spout
water-spout.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.

eruption.label: Eruption
eruption.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.

needle-arm.label: Needle Arm
needle-arm.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

poison-tail.label: Poison Tail
poison-tail.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.

weather-ball.label: Weather Ball
weather-ball.effect: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.

mist-ball.label: Mist Ball
mist-ball.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

luster-purge.label: Luster Purge
luster-purge.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

doom-desire.label: Doom Desire
doom-desire.effect: Hits the target two turns later.

psycho-boost.label: Psycho Boost
psycho-boost.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
